integrity: Uniform symbolic proof, backed by exhaustive small-field computations. No external person has yet independently audited these calculations, the bibliographic comparisons, or the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only 2-by-2 matrices in odd characteristic; the homogeneous zero count is previously known. No extension to characteristic two or higher matrix sizes is claimed.
title: Complete prescribed-value fibers of the \(2\times2\) matrix anticommutator over odd finite fields
